query.params: package_name, fix_epoch, fix_version, fix_release, fix_type, product_name, os_product_family, os_product_version, cve_name, severity

mode.name: get_vulnerable_packages
mode.query: SELECT s.id AS server_id, cve.name, vulnerablePkg.name AS package_name, (vulnerablePkg.fix_version).epoch AS fix_epoch, (vulnerablePkg.fix_version).version AS fix_version, (vulnerablePkg.fix_version).release AS fix_release, (vulnerablePkg.fix_version).type AS fix_type, vulnerablePkg.fix_version IS NULL OR vulnerablePkg.fix_version > pe.evr AS affected FROM rhnCVE cve JOIN suseovalplatformvulnerable platVulnerable ON platVulnerable.cve_id = cve.id AND cve.name = :cve_name JOIN suseovalplatform platform ON platform.id = platVulnerable.platform_id JOIN rhnServer s ON (starts_with(s.cpe, platform.cpe) OR starts_with(platform.cpe, s.cpe)) AND s.id IN (%s) JOIN suseovalvulnerablepackage vulnerablePkg ON vulnerablePkg.plat_vuln_id = platVulnerable.id JOIN rhnPackageName pn ON pn.name = vulnerablePkg.name JOIN rhnServerPackage sp ON sp.server_id = s.id AND sp.name_id = pn.id JOIN rhnPackageEVR pe ON pe.id = sp.evr_id ORDER BY s.id, vulnerablePkg.name;

mode.name: can_audit_cve
mode.query: SELECT 1 FROM suseOVALPlatformVulnerable platVul, rhncve cve WHERE platVul.cve_id = cve.id AND cve.name = :cve_name;

mode.name: list_oval_platform_cpes
mode.query: SELECT plat.cpe AS cpe FROM suseOVALPlatform plat;

mode.name: check_errata_availability
mode.query: SELECT 1 FROM suseCVEServerChannel, rhnChannelErrata WHERE suseCVEServerChannel.channel_id = rhnChannelErrata.channel_id AND server_id = :server_id

mode.name: list_servers_with_errata
mode.query: SELECT userServerPerms.server_id AS server_id FROM rhnUserServerPerms userServerPerms WHERE userServerPerms.user_id = :user_id AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM suseCVEServerChannel cveServerChannel JOIN rhnChannelErrata channelErrata ON cveServerChannel.channel_id = channelErrata.channel_id WHERE cveServerChannel.server_id = userServerPerms.server_id );

write-mode.name: clear_oval_metadata_by_os_product
delete_old_oval_metadata

mode.name: list_system_cve_errata
mode.query: SELECT DISTINCT ON (errataCve.cve_id, errata.id) errataCve.cve_id AS cve_id, errata.id AS errata_id, errata.advisory AS advisory, channel.label AS channel_label, serverChannel.channel_id IS NOT NULL AS assigned FROM rhnErrataCVE errataCve JOIN rhnErrata errata ON errata.id = errataCve.errata_id JOIN rhnErrataPackage errataPkg ON errataPkg.errata_id = errata.id JOIN rhnPackage pkg ON pkg.id = errataPkg.package_id JOIN rhnPackageEVR pkgEvr ON pkgEvr.id = pkg.evr_id JOIN rhnChannelErrata channelErrata ON channelErrata.errata_id = errata.id JOIN rhnChannelPackage channelPkg ON channelPkg.channel_id = channelErrata.channel_id AND channelPkg.package_id = pkg.id JOIN suseCVEServerChannel cveChannel ON cveChannel.server_id = :sid AND cveChannel.channel_id = channelErrata.channel_id AND cveChannel.channel_rank < :max_rank JOIN rhnChannel channel ON channel.id = channelErrata.channel_id LEFT JOIN rhnServerChannel serverChannel ON serverChannel.server_id = :sid AND serverChannel.channel_id = channelErrata.channel_id WHERE errataCve.cve_id IN (%s) AND pkgEvr.evr > (SELECT max(installedEvr.evr) FROM rhnServerPackage installed JOIN rhnPackageEVR installedEvr ON installedEvr.id = installed.evr_id WHERE installed.server_id = :sid AND installed.name_id = pkg.name_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rhnServerPackage installed JOIN rhnPackageUpgradeArchCompat archCompat ON archCompat.package_arch_id = installed.package_arch_id WHERE installed.server_id = :sid AND installed.name_id = pkg.name_id AND archCompat.package_upgrade_arch_id = pkg.package_arch_id) ORDER BY errataCve.cve_id, errata.id, assigned DESC, cveChannel.channel_rank
